name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, grasp a barbell just outside shoulder width with an overhand grip, and hinge forward at the hips with soft knees.
Brace your core with a flat spine so the bar hangs straight down beneath your shoulders.
Drive your elbows smoothly behind you to pull the bar toward your lower ribs while squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar slowly back to full arm extension without changing your torso angle.
tips: Keep the bar close to your body and avoid jerking your torso upright to heave the weight.
Keep your neck neutral by looking slightly down at the floor ahead of you.
